description: Source code for POS Invoice handling in ERPNext, including validation, payment processing, stock checks, and loyalty transactions.

classes.name: POSInvoice
classes.description: Class representing a Point of Sale Invoice, extending SalesInvoice with POS-specific validation and processing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving the POS invoice, including stock, serial numbers, and loyalty points.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions upon submitting the invoice, such as loyalty points and coupon updates.

methods.name: before_cancel
methods.description: Checks for related POS Closing Entries before allowing cancellation.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles cleanup actions when cancelling the invoice, including loyalty point deletion.

methods.name: check_phone_payments
methods.description: Validates phone-based payments are completed.

methods.name: validate_pos_reserved_serial_nos
methods.description: Validates that serial numbers reserved for POS are not already transacted.

methods.name: validate_delivered_serial_nos
methods.description: Checks if serial numbers have already been transacted into another sales invoice.

methods.name: validate_stock_availablility
methods.description: Ensures stock is available for sale, considering serial numbers and stock settings.

methods.name: validate_serialised_or_batched_item
methods.description: Validates serial and batch number selections for items.

methods.name: validate_return_items_qty
methods.description: Ensures return invoices do not have positive quantities and serial numbers are valid.

methods.name: validate_non_stock_items
methods.description: Checks that only stock items are included in POS invoices.

methods.name: validate_mode_of_payment
methods.description: Ensures at least one mode of payment is provided.

methods.name: validate_change_account
methods.description: Validates that change account belongs to the same company.

methods.name: validate_change_amount
methods.description: Calculates and validates change amount and associated account.

methods.name: validate_payment_amount
methods.description: Validates that payment amounts are positive or negative as appropriate.

methods.name: validate_loyalty_transaction
methods.description: Validates loyalty points redemption and account details.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the invoice based on its current state and due date.

methods.name: set_pos_fields
methods.description: Sets POS profile related fields and defaults.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Populates missing invoice fields with POS profile defaults.

methods.name: reset_mode_of_payments
methods.description: Resets payment modes based on POS profile.

methods.name: set_account_for_mode_of_payment
methods.description: Assigns accounts to payment modes if missing.

methods.name: create_payment_request
methods.description: Creates a payment request for phone payments.

methods.name: get_new_payment_request
methods.description: Constructs a new payment request object.

methods.name: get_existing_payment_request
methods.description: Retrieves an existing payment request if available.
